hero.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: hero photograph for a professional mobile-first food rescue web app in Cali, Colombia. Primary request: beautiful editorial food photography of a reusable natural wooden produce crate filled with fresh imperfect-but-wholesome vegetables, ripe tomatoes, leafy greens, carrots, a couple of seasonal fruits and a paper bag with artisan bread, ready to donate. Scene/backdrop: clean pale sage and white studio tabletop with soft natural window light; no people. Composition/framing: wide landscape composition around 3:2, food crate on the right two thirds, airy pale sage negative space to the left; slightly elevated front three-quarter view, close enough to feel appetizing, fully visible crate and food, quiet background. Style: premium food delivery editorial photography, realistic tactile textures, natural food colors, elegant and inviting, subtle real shadows. Constraints: no text, no logos, no labels, no typography, no watermark, no UI, no collage borders; the food looks fresh and safe.

redesign_v2.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: Square food photograph for a premium Spanish food-rescue mobile webapp; reusable as a circular category thumbnail and rectangular food donation card.
Scene/backdrop: Seamless perfectly uniform warm cream background and floor, color #fff4e8, with no horizon line.
Style/medium: Highly realistic appetizing premium studio food photography, tangible natural textures, commercial quality.
Composition/framing: Square 1:1 canvas, centered subject occupying about 70 percent of the image, fully visible with generous breathing room at every edge, frontal three-quarter camera angle looking slightly downward, all essential food within the central circular safe area.
Lighting/mood: Soft broad studio light from upper left, gentle warm highlights, soft contact shadows directly beneath food; calm welcoming and fresh.
Color palette: Natural ingredient colors on the exact warm cream backdrop, no dramatic saturated backdrop.
Text: None.
Constraints: One cohesive arrangement, realistic food proportions, no typography, no logos, no labels, no brands, no watermark, no emojis, no people or hands, no chicken-brand buckets, no restaurant branding, no props unrelated to the specified food.
Primary request: An abundant compact arrangement of fresh assorted vegetables.
Subject: Two ripe red tomatoes, one fresh broccoli crown, a yellow bell pepper, two carrots with short green stems, and a small zucchini, composed naturally as a tidy produce group. Fresh wholesome ingredients with slight realistic imperfections, no crates or packaging.
